emergency_portable_shelter.name: EPS Insulated Panels
emergency_portable_shelter.desc: Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) structural panels. Highly rapid deployment, excellent insulation, very lightweight.

emergency_portable_shelter.name: Aerogel Composite
emergency_portable_shelter.desc: Advanced aerogel infused fabric panels. Extremely thin and lightweight with industry-leading thermal resistance.

emergency_portable_shelter.name: Hollow Polymer
emergency_portable_shelter.desc: Extruded hollow recycled polymer interlocking panels. Can be filled with sand or earth on-site for mass.

emergency_portable_shelter.name: Corrugated Galvanized Iron
emergency_portable_shelter.desc: Standard corrugated metal sheets. Ubiquitous, cheap, durable, but offers poor thermal resistance without insulation.

emergency_portable_shelter.name: Low-E Aluminum Sheet
emergency_portable_shelter.desc: Aluminum roofing with a low-emissivity finish to reflect radiant heat in extreme conditions.

permanent_community_shelter.name: PIR Foam Board
permanent_community_shelter.desc: Polyisocyanurate foam panels providing superior thermal resistance and fire performance for emergency use.

permanent_community_shelter.name: Modular Hempcrete
permanent_community_shelter.desc: Pre-cast modular hempcrete panels. Carbon negative, breathable, and provides decent thermal mass.

permanent_community_shelter.name: High-Albedo Cool Roof
permanent_community_shelter.desc: Membrane roof with highly reflective white coating to drastically reduce solar heat gain in hot climates.

permanent_community_shelter.name: Solar Absorbent Membrane
permanent_community_shelter.desc: Dark roofing membrane designed specifically to maximize solar heat gain in extreme cold/arctic deployments.
